Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Honk's Quick Reaction tester - in the "Quick Reaction" sheet, double-tapping the big preview emoji fires bursts of hearts that scale up, float upward, and fade, demonstrating the reaction.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
"Quick Reaction" sheet over the dimmed profile (Benji): title, "Choose an emoji to use for your quick reaction in chats" subcopy, a large red heart as the current reaction preview, a small emoji-picker affordance, and a Save button. Double-tapping the heart fills the sheet with floating hearts.

## Motion spec
Pattern: double-tap heart burst in a preview sheet.
- Sheet entrance: slides up over dimmed profile (spring ~300/24, 350ms).
- Double-tap the preview: the big heart pulses (scale 1 -> 1.15 -> 1, 180ms) and 6-10 red hearts burst from its center (scale 0 -> 1 with 50ms stagger), floating upward (translateY -120 to -260pt over 900-1300ms) with sway (+-20pt at ~1.5Hz) and slight rotation (+-20deg), fading in the last 300ms.
- Hearts vary in size (12-28pt) and drift speed for depth.
- Repeated double-taps stack new bursts on fading ones.
- Choosing a different emoji from the picker swaps the preview (crossfade + scale pop, 200ms) and changes the burst glyph to match.

## Calibration
- The burst glyph always matches the current preview emoji - hearts here, but it follows selection.
- The burst lives inside the sheet; it clips at the sheet's rounded top corners.

## Reduced motion
The preview heart pulses once per double-tap; no floating burst.

## Don't miss
- The big preview heart stays put - only spawned hearts float.
- Save remains secondary; the double-tap playground is the star of the sheet.
